exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Bitcoin (BTC) traded at $77,850.00 as of 2026-11-01 06:21:53 UTC, +0.05% over one hour and +0.83% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $77,191.00 to $77,809.00; spot sits at 107% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -3.77% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($77,509.82) is below the 72-hour average ($78,074.07). Spot is 4.70% below the seven-day high of $81,691.75 and 1.95% above the seven-day low of $76,360.18.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 1.98% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 68.2, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $46.03 billion, equal to 2.94% of the $1.57 trillion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 34 ("Fear"), versus 54 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink BTC/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $77,756.60, 23 minutes before the spot quote and -0.12% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price sits at $77,850, a modest 0.05% rise in the last hour and 0.83% over 24 hours, placing it above the midpoint of the 24‑hour range (107% of range) and indicating short‑term bullish pressure despite a seven‑day downtrend [Ex. A, B].  

2. Realized volatility remains low at 1.98% per day, and the 14‑hour RSI at 68.2 signals neither over‑bought nor oversold conditions, allowing a controlled long entry with limited downside risk [Ex. D].  

3. Liquidity is robust ($46.03 bn, 2.94% of market cap) and the Chainlink feed, the settlement benchmark, is only 0.12% below spot, ensuring price fidelity for the practice position [Ex. E, G].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price is perched at $77,850, merely 0.05% above its one‑hour bar and 0.83% above 24‑hour, yet the 24‑hour range of $77,191‑$77,809 places the current level 107% of that range, indicating a breakout beyond recent bounds and a short‑term overextension ripe for correction [Ex. A, B].  

2. Momentum metrics confirm weakening demand: the seven‑day average sits below the 72‑hour average and the price is 4.70% under the seven‑day high, while the RSI of 68.2, though neutral, trends downward from prior peaks, suggesting imminent downside pressure [Ex. C, D].  

3. Market sentiment has shifted into Fear at a index of 34, down from 54 a week ago, and volume remains modest at 2.94% of market cap, limiting bullish absorption and amplifying the impact of any sell pressure [Ex. E, F]; the Chainlink feed, the settlement benchmark, is already marginally lower than spot, reinforcing the case for a short entry [Ex. G].  

The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s “breakout” claim collapses on Exhibit B: the spot sits at 107 % of the 24‑hour range only because the range’s upper bound is $77,809, a mere $41 above spot—statistically insignificant and well within normal intraday jitter, not a true overextension. Moreover, the Bear cites “weakening demand” via the RSI, yet Exhibit D shows the 14‑hour RSI at 68.2, comfortably below the overbought threshold of 70; it is still firmly in neutral territory, offering no decisive bearish signal. Thus the alleged momentum shift is unsubstantiated. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull leans on a fleeting 0.05% hourly uptick and a 0.83% 24‑hour gain while ignoring the broader seven‑day decline of 3.77% and a 4.70% gap below the recent high, evidence that bearish momentum dominates [Ex. C]. Moreover, the “neutral” RSI of 68.2 is well above the 50‑midpoint and edging toward over‑bought territory, contradicting the claim of safe entry; combined with a fear‑driven sentiment index at 34, the market is predisposed to further downside [Ex. D, F]. These factors outweigh the modest volatility and liquidity cited. Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds short‑term bearish pressure outweighs bullish cues.

findings.finding: Spot price up 0.05% hour and 0.83% day but still below 7‑day high
Current price exceeds 24‑hour range upper bound by only 0.05%, indicating a fragile breakout
Seven‑day trend down 3.77% and price 4.70% below recent high
RSI 68.2 sits near overbought threshold and momentum is weakening
Fear & Greed Index at 34 (Fear), down from 54 a week earlier

ruling.opinion: The exhibits show modest short‑term gains but a broader seven‑day decline, price barely breaching its recent range, RSI approaching overbought, and fear‑driven sentiment. These factors combine to suggest downside risk outweighs limited upside, justifying a short practice position for the next 24 hours.
ruling.dissent: Bull argues low volatility and solid liquidity support a safe long, but the prevailing downward trend, fragile breakout, and fear sentiment indicate stronger bearish odds.
